Paribus, the first cross-chain lending platform on Cardano, was attacked and lost about $100,000. The reason for the attack is that it uses a fork of an old version of Compound V2, which has a known reentrancy vulnerability.

Paribus, a lending protocol on Arbitrum, was exploited on 11 April 2023 through a reentrancy bug in its CompoundV2-forked logic, resulting in losses estimated around $67,800,$100,000. The attack abused the lack of proper reentrancy protection during a token redemption sequence. A known reentrancy vulnerability in Paribus's CompoundV2-forked redeem logic allowed an attacker contract to re-enter and perform multiple borrow and withdraw operations before balances were updated.
